reason: I have never heard of Capabble and no principal I know uses it, so I will not put it before the chairman. The exam-centre module is tempting because Form 66 and dispatch are such a headache, but a website sign-up does not tell me who will sit with my office staff and enter our data.
objection: Who will train my staff and enter our data? My office clerks are not comfortable with computers, and a 14-day trial is no use if nobody comes to the school to set it up. If it fails during board exams, the blame falls on me.
would_change_my_mind: A principal from a nearby CBSE school telling me they ran their exam centre on it, plus someone coming to our school to load our data and train the office staff.
